Compact the target's conversation

Usage:
  cmux compact

Sends /compact.

This fires immediately, even if the target is in the middle of a turn. When
aimed at the pane you are calling from, that means it compacts while your own
turn is still running. cmux warns when it spots that; --defer buys you time.

Example:
  cmux compact

Flags:
  --to <target>      pane id (%12), session:window.pane, or an index from cmux panes
  --all-panes        allow a target that was not detected as Claude Code
  --dry-run          print the tmux calls instead of making them
  --defer <seconds>  have tmux deliver the keys later, via run-shell
  --self             allow interrupt to target the pane cmux was run from
  -h, --help         show help
  --version          show version
